source.commit_subject: Add Hugging Face Paper badge to README

paper.title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
paper.note: Paper id, title and authors are taken from the pinned upstream README and CITATION.bib. This experiment did not open the paper text (no network); it is a source-bound characterization, not a paper reading.

runtime.note: Fresh execution requires numpy, networkx and tqdm; no dependency installation, weights, online inference or credentials are required by this experiment.
runtime.timestamp_note: All observation timestamps are explicit, timezone-naive synthetic inputs. The summary callback supplies text only; upstream gives that derived node timestamp=None.

defaults.note: Explicit configuration of this source experiment; not a full reproduction of the shipped profile or paper run.

controller.note: Scripted numeric defaults are 0.9 except listed zero-default control; coverage-token questions default to zero; per-case overrides take precedence. Choice uses the stated selection probability. These are supplied values, not model predictions.

cases.title: Admission 关闭：类型分数全零仍写入
cases.why_this_case: upstream build() only reads admission scores when admission_enabled; with it off the memory is stored regardless of what the system-one answer would have been. This is the negative control for a later rejection.
cases.intervention: 关闭 admission，给定四种 memory type 分数均为 0；检查合法 observation 是否仍保存。

sequence.text: Alice plans to move to Lisbon later this year.

cases.title: Admission 打开：低分拒绝且不写入
cases.why_this_case: With admission_enabled the admission score gates the write; a zeroed admission vector must leave no node, vector or link behind.
cases.intervention: admission_enabled=True; admission_scores all 0.0 (redundancy 1.0) so admission score 0.0 < threshold 0.60.

cases.title: Admission 打开：高分允许写入
cases.why_this_case: Positive control that complements the rejection: same code path, admission vector set to one, so the observation must be stored with its admission/type metadata.
cases.intervention: admission_enabled=True; admission vector set to 1.0 so admission score 1.0 >= threshold.

sequence.text: Bob adopted a rescue greyhound named Pepper.

cases.title: obsolete 概率很高时，原始证据仍被保留，只落一条判断
cases.why_this_case: consolidate() records the obsolete probability in the node's consolidation decision but never deletes the candidate; this pins the difference between a returned probability and a storage change.
cases.intervention: consolidate(); pair_0_obsolete=0.95, everything else 0.0, representation=keep_separate. 调用前已通过真实 build 保存两条 observation；只比较随后一次 consolidate 前后。

sequence.text: Dana lives in Porto and commutes by train.
Dana now lives in Braga after the summer move.

cases.title: obsolete 概率很低时，存储变化与高 obsolete 相同
cases.why_this_case: Paired control for the obsolete case: only the recorded decision differs; the node/vector/summary counts must not. This isolates the scalar from the storage effect.
cases.intervention: consolidate(); pair_0_obsolete=0.05, everything else 0.0, representation=keep_separate. 调用前已通过真实 build 保存两条 observation；只比较随后一次 consolidate 前后。

sequence.text: Dana lives in Porto and commutes by train.
Dana now lives in Braga after the summer move.

cases.title: 高 contradiction 保留两份 account，并加一条 CONTRADICTS 语义链
cases.why_this_case: With contradiction above threshold the subtype becomes CONTRADICTS and a semantic link is added; both source nodes must remain.
cases.intervention: consolidate(); pair_0_contradiction=0.95, representation=keep_separate. 调用前已通过真实 build 保存两条 observation；只比较随后一次 consolidate 前后。

sequence.text: The team shipped release 3.2 on the first of August.
The team did not ship release 3.2 in August.

cases.title: 要求 merge 但没有 summarizer 时，只落判断与链接
cases.why_this_case: consolidate() only builds a derived representation inside 'if summarizer and ...'; without a summarizer the merge decision is recorded but no summary node exists.
cases.intervention: consolidate(summarizer=None); pair_0_redundant=0.9, representation=merge with confidence 1.0. 调用前已通过真实 build 保存两条 observation；只比较随后一次 consolidate 前后。

sequence.text: Eli keeps the weekly grocery list in the kitchen drawer.
Eli stores the weekly grocery list in the kitchen drawer.

cases.title: 要求 merge 且提供 summarizer 时，落一条派生 summary node
cases.why_this_case: Paired with the no-summarizer case; identical answers, but the presence of a summarizer must add exactly one derived node with source=jev_mem_consolidation.
cases.intervention: consolidate(summarizer=deterministic join); pair_0_redundant=0.9, representation=merge with confidence 1.0. 调用前已通过真实 build 保存两条 observation；只比较随后一次 consolidate 前后。

sequence.text: Eli keeps the weekly grocery list in the kitchen drawer.
Eli stores the weekly grocery list in the kitchen drawer.

cases.title: 即使 representation=merge，高 contradiction 仍阻止 summary
cases.why_this_case: The summary branch requires scores['contradiction'] < threshold. A merge choice with a high contradiction must not reach the summarizer.
cases.intervention: consolidate(summarizer=deterministic join); pair_0_redundant=0.9, pair_0_contradiction=0.95, representation=merge. 调用前已通过真实 build 保存两条 observation；只比较随后一次 consolidate 前后。

sequence.text: The lab moved the freezer to the second floor in June.
The lab did not move the freezer in June.

cases.title: merge 的 choice confidence 低于阈值时，即使有 summarizer 也不落 summary
cases.why_this_case: The summary branch also requires representation.probabilities[choice] >= consolidation_threshold. A merge with choice probability 0.5 must be blocked.
cases.intervention: consolidate(summarizer=deterministic join); pair_0_redundant=0.9, representation=merge with choice probability 0.5 (keep_separate 0.5). 调用前已通过真实 build 保存两条 observation；只比较随后一次 consolidate 前后。

sequence.text: The greenhouse tomatoes are watered every morning.
The greenhouse tomatoes get watered each morning.
